description: This Java source file defines the HumanResEvents class, which provides static methods to generate hierarchical data structures (likely for a UI tree component) related to human resources entities such as employees, departments, and organizational groups within the OFBiz framework. It interacts with the database via OFBiz entity engine to retrieve employee positions, party relationships, and party names, and constructs JSON-like maps for frontend consumption.

classes.name: HumanResEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to build hierarchical HR data structures for UI components, including employees, departments, and organizational groups.

methods.name: getChildHRCategoryTree
methods.description: Main method to retrieve and assemble the HR category tree data, including employee details, child departments, and employees within a party.

methods.name: getCurrentEmployeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves employee position fulfillment details for a given party ID, returning a list of JSON-like maps for frontend display.

methods.name: getChildComps
methods.description: Fetches child organizational units or departments related to a party group, constructing JSON-like maps for UI tree nodes.

methods.name: getEmployeeInComp
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific party ID, returning data suitable for UI tree display.
